verdict.rationale: Release changelog generation is a fair question for a project-tracking tool, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions changelogs, release notes or release-based summaries. Generic automation ('Automate tasks and workflows'), AI writing help, and API and Power-Up building blocks are adjacent features or developer primitives, not this capability.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can auto-generate a changelog for each release so shipping progress is easy to review
